description: BLOB_EDGE_SD_LOOP_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md: the sd loop's recognize/mint duality reapplied to CORRESPONDENCE persistence, not to observation-vs-codebook decode. `_shared_shape` (domains/reflective_faculty.py, UNCHANGED by this seed) already collapses two signatures onto shared held RelationCue structure (I_A -> S + r_A, I_B -> S + r_B, S = the shared RelationCue axis set); this seed's rules decide, for one computed correspondence, whether it RECOGNIZES an already-held structural pattern (blob_recognize, mirrors sd_dedup_existing's status-only terminal -- 'add_edge targets must be match-bound vars in this engine', so a Term-found existing BlobEdge cannot be edged-to within the rule) or MINTS a genuinely new one (blob_mint, mirrors sd_mint_quantum's add_node+add_edge shape, guarded so a recurring transform_key never re-mints). Per the creator's mid-flight correction (MDL framing, L(G_t+1) ~= L(G_t) + L(r_t) + L(E_t)): minting/recognizing fires AT COLLAPSE TIME (the first time a Correspondence node is decided, not after a recurrence threshold) -- re-read directly against sd_mint_quantum's own novelty guard, which already fires on first occurrence, never on a second sighting. A Correspondence with NO shared axis at all (shared_count<=0, no collapse onto anything held) terminates honestly via blob_no_collapse -- there is no larger residual-accumulation concept at the PAIRWISE-correspondence grain the way there is for a single Observation's unexplained predicates, so this is explicitly a narrower re-instance of the sd ladder (rungs 1/4 only -- recognize/mint -- never rungs 2/3 transform/infer, which have no defined meaning for a two-operand comparison with no codebook of many parts to decode against). Python (domains/reflective_faculty.py::record_correspondence) does mechanical ingest only, mirroring domains/meta_shape.py::observe byte-for-byte: write the Correspondence node + about_a/about_b edges to the two REAL ShapeSignature nodes, run_rules(), read back the verdict. No Python decision.

microtheory.name: blob_edge_correspondence
microtheory.description: a correspondence collapses onto held structure (recognize, reuse) or names a new pattern (mint, once) -- tick-driven, no Python decision.

rules.name: blob_mint
rules.comment: DYNAMIC QUANTIZATION, one level up: a pending Correspondence whose shared_count is positive (the two signatures collapsed onto >=1 held RelationCue axis) and whose transform_key matches NO existing BlobEdge names a genuinely NEW correspondence pattern. Mints the BlobEdge (mirrors sd_mint_quantum's add_node+add_edge shape exactly) and links BOTH endpoints -- na/nb are match-bound (3-triple match), not Term-found, so add_edge to them is legal (see sd_dedup_existing's own documented constraint, reused here rather than reinvented).

rules.name: blob_recognize
rules.comment: RECOGNIZE, mirroring sd_dedup_existing's exact terminal shape: a pending Correspondence whose transform_key ALREADY matches a held BlobEdge collapses onto held structure that is ALREADY persisted -- the correspondence PATTERN is not new, so no new BlobEdge is minted. 'add_edge targets must be match-bound vars in this engine' (sd_dedup_existing's own comment) means the existing BlobEdge, found via a Term search (Exists), cannot be edged-to within this rule -- status-only, exactly as sd_dedup_existing leaves the matching CapabilityAxis un-edged and lets Python re-resolve it by the same identity key afterward (there: capability_keys: here: transform_key).

rules.name: blob_no_collapse
rules.comment: TERMINAL, fixpoint hygiene only (parallel to giving every sd_* Observation a definite status): a pending Correspondence with shared_count<=0 collapsed onto NOTHING held at all -- no shared RelationCue axis, no structure to recognize or mint a pattern from. This is honestly out of the sd ladder's residual-accumulation scope (a pairwise Correspondence has no 'unexplained predicate list' the way a single Observation does), so it is recorded as a definite no_collapse status, not silently left pending forever and not forced into mint.
